item.title: Ballygunner deliver in second-half against St Martin's for All-Ireland club SHC final berth
item.description: Ballygunner came good in the second-half to see off St Martin's by 0-19 to 0-10 at Semple Stadium and book their place in next month's All-Ireland club senior hurling championship final against Loughrea.

item.title: Sexton takes Geraldines reins
item.description: Ronan Sexton has replaced fellow-Down man Micheál Magill as the new manager of Louth intermediate side Geraldines.

item.title: Curran appointed Loup manager
item.description: Maxi Curran is the new manager of Derry senior football club Loup.

item.title: Athy management steps down
item.description: Kildare senior football champions Athy are on the lookout for a new management after joint-managers Ross Bell and Conor Ronan along with coach Paddy Dunne stepped down.

item.title: Dublin great Curran takes charge of Skerries
item.description: Former Dublin star Paul Curran has been appointed Skerries Harps' new senior football manager.

item.title: Thurles to host All-Ireland camogie club final replay
item.description: FBD Semple Stadium will host the All-Ireland club senior camogie championship final replay between Athenry and St Finbarr's on Saturday, January 3.

item.title: Kerry legend O'Mahony returns to his roots
item.description: Aidan O'Mahony will take charge of his home club Rathmore in 2026.

item.title: 'We got a bit of momentum and stayed going'
item.description: Ballygunner boss Jason Ryan was delighted with his side's second half performance after they saw off St Martin's to qualify for only their second-ever All-Ireland club SHC final.

item.title: All-Ireland club final fixture details confirmed
item.description: The GAA has announced the times and dates for the All-Ireland club football and hurling finals in Croke Park next month.
